payload.detail: 2026-11-05 backend audit (DEL-01, R06), local source33f6478: False-green monitor summary is repaired locally; current deployed notification delivery, recurring Sentry-group coverage and release-correlated diagnosis remain unverified. New-group webhook semantics alone do not prove recurrence detection.
